description: This file defines a comprehensive GitLab prompt management system, including classes and functions for loading, parsing, rendering, caching, and managing prompt templates stored in GitLab repositories. It integrates with GitLab via a client, supports folder scoping, YAML frontmatter parsing, and provides both synchronous and asynchronous methods for prompt processing within a larger prompt management framework.

classes.name: GitLabPromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a prompt template loaded from GitLab, encapsulating its ID, content, metadata, and model parameters.

classes.name: GitLabTemplateManager
classes.description: Manages loading and rendering prompt templates from GitLab repositories, supporting folder paths and YAML frontmatter parsing.

classes.name: GitLabPromptManagement
classes.description: Main class implementing prompt management functionalities, including loading, rendering, pre- and post-call hooks, and prompt validation tailored for GitLab-stored prompts.

classes.name: GitLabPromptCache
classes.description: Caches all prompt files from a GitLab repository into memory for quick access, supporting reloads and listing of prompt files and IDs.
